messages:
Clara Ngo: Quick sync  we need final hero hooks + CTA behavior for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages for the benchmark post & webinar next week. Can we lock copy + routing today?

Diego Ramos: Recommendation: Hosted = low-friction trial; Dedicated = qualification + perf details; Private = sales + compliance. Keep CTAs semantically different so analytics can tie intent.

Riley Chen: Draft CTAs: Hosted primary = "Start hosted trial" / secondary = "See latency & pricing". Dedicated primary = "Book throughput demo" / secondary = "View benchmarks". Private primary = "Contact sales for private deploy" / secondary = "Request compliance pack".

Sam Wu: Routing notes: Hosted -> signup funnel (utm_source=site&utm_campaign=hosted_launch). Dedicated -> /leads/dedicated payload with hidden `preferred_qps` and `latency_target`. Private -> AE queue + attach SOC/SLA pdf. Add `page_variant=hero_test` for the A/B.

Clara Ngo: Webinar framing: 20-min demo + 15-min live Q&A; include a slide with p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens for each deployment mode. Working title: "Serving LLMs: cost, latency, and control".

Jordan (growth-bot): :robot_face: I can export audience: anyone who requested Dedicated demo in last 9 months + visitors to /pricing > 45s. Say the word and I'll build the invite list.

Diego Ramos: Small copy tweaks: Hosted hero: "Start building with a managed inference API"; Dedicated hero: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput"; Private hero: "Run inference inside your VPC or on-prem".

Riley Chen: I'll wire the form endpoints and ensure the hidden UTM + `cta_type` param are captured. ETA tomorrow morning.

Clara Ngo: Great. Action items: Riley = implement forms + UTMs, Diego = finalize hero lines and blog outline, Sam = bench runs for numbers to cite, Jordan = export invite list. Deadline: EOD Wednesday so eng can deploy on Thursday.

Sam Wu: I'll run the bench script Monday night and share CSVs (hosted runtime, dedicated quantized, private baseline).

Clara Ngo: Thanks all. Quick ask: avoid describing Hosted as "enterprise-ready" on the hero. Keep enterprise language on Dedicated/Private. Ping me if you hit blockers. :raised_hands:
